entry.title: MeowSynth 1.0.1
entry.summary: knobster's MeowSynth rebuilt as a native MPC OS plugin, with the original's look and the meowing cat. **Install:** needs root SSH on the MPC (a modded unit). Drop the zip into the [MPC plugin installer](https://github.com/sd88me/mpc-vst-plugins/releases/latest), or unzip it on the device and run `sh install.sh` as root.
